forum.title: STM32CubeMX2 Cpp support
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi ​@roroc0, and welcome to the ST Community,

STM32CubeMX2 cannot generate C++ files. However, after project generation, you can include C++ files in your project and use them.

Please do not hesitate to get back to me if you need more details or further assistance.

Regards,

Sara.
forum.content_text:
Hi all,

I am wondering if CubeMX2 + STM32C562RE are able to support cpp main applications?

Thanks in advance
